dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: I wonder if my life would have been easier had I not chosen this topic back then?

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: Maybe I'd have gone with something my seniors had studied before, and done a synthesis of some kind...

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: I'd have edited the data to get the result I wanted... Not like anyone would want to replicate such dull research anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: That's what they call "shooting first and drawing the target later," yes? Either way, I just wanted you to know that research is mostly a process of muddling along.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That doesn't seem to apply to you.

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: *sigh* I fear I was just an idiot who didn't realize what was going on. Our mentor was quite strict with us, too, so I just ended up on this path.

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: But since I'm here, I might as well go all the way. Ah, I do hope the experiment goes well — it's either that, or I'm done for once my mentor gets out of bed next month!
